no-restricted-globals.name: $fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Use api() from app/utils/api.ts - it ends the session on a 401, a bare $fetch does not.

no-restricted-globals.name: useFetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Use useApi() from app/utils/api.ts - it ends the session on a 401, a bare useFetch does not.

no-restricted-globals.name: useLazyFetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Use useApi(..., { lazy: true }) - it ends the session on a 401, a bare useLazyFetch does not.

paths.name: ofetch
paths.message: Use api() / useApi() from app/utils/api.ts. Importing ofetch directly is the one way around the session handling.

paths.name: nodemailer
paths.message: Send through sendMail() in server/utils/mail.ts. It is the one place that diverts every mail to NUXT_MAIL_DEV_TO in development - a second transport would not.
